theorem: For the original trace18 PPT/SN3 5x5 grid, the 4x5 local projection K3=v0|0>+v1|1>, K4=|3>, K0,K1,K2 fixed has SN<=2 whenever |v0|^2<=1/4 and |v1|^2>=1. The latter coordinate is completely unbounded, so this is a noncompact region of genuine support-three kernels. Source swap symmetry gives the Bob version, and any opposite local map preserves SR2. This is a sufficient region only, not an unrestricted 4x4 result.
seven_phase_import: The exact Laurent-polynomial rank2 seed and phase identity are given in frontier-20261028-grid55-original-seven-phase-v1.json SHA256 aa81e367b67782a8fa41cf1633632435b642c9f24aa6e4de7b222f0ae7895626. Importantly its rank2 row identity holds for EVERY complex parameter s, not only the previously chosen s=1/(2v1). For any s, set t1=(s,1-v1*s,-v1*(1-v1*s)), t2=(0,v0*s,v0*(1-2*v1*s)), t3=(0,0,v0^2*s), in basis (F',B',H'), and G(s)=diag(2,1,1)-sum_j t_j t_j^*. Whenever G(s)>=0, the seven-phase average plus G(s) and the untouched source generators is an exact SR2 decomposition.
s_equals_inverse: For v1!=0 take s=1/v1 and write U=|v0|^2,R=|v1|^2. Then t1=(1/v1,0,0), t2=(0,v0/v1,-v0), t3=(0,0,v0^2/v1). Thus G(s) is the direct sum of scalar 2-1/R and the 2x2 Hermitian block [[1-U/R,U/v1],[U/conjugate(v1),1-U-U^2/R]]. Its exact PSD test is 2-1/R>=0, both block diagonal entries nonnegative, and (1-U/R)*(1-U-U^2/R)-U^2/R>=0. Any point satisfying this test is also certified, even outside the simple strip.
uniform_unbounded_strip: If U<=1/4 and R>=1, the scalar is at least1; the block diagonals are at least3/4 and11/16; and the squared offdiagonal is at most1/16. Thus the determinant is at least (3/4)*(11/16)-1/16=29/64>0. Both blocks are positive definite. This all-variable inequality establishes the claimed strip for every phase and every size of v1.
example: For v0=1/2,v1=3, the kernel span{|3>-(1/2)|0>-3|1>} has support3 and lies far outside the preceding bounded s=1/(2v1) region. The exact residual pivots are [17/9,35/36,3709/5040]; both 4x5 and 5x4 output partial transposes are PSD. No assertion that either output is entangled is needed for SN<=2.

exact_check.observed: At four Gaussian-rational inputs, including (1/2,3), (i/2,1+i), (0,1) and the out-of-strip negative control (2,3), all forty Laurent-polynomial rank minors vanish, both 400-entry output identities and actual PT checks pass. Grams are PSD in the three strip cases and non-PSD at the negative control. The checker hash-pins/replays the predecessor seven-phase cases. No failure of this particular Gram proves a Schmidt-number lower bound.

limits: Only the stated chart and its tensor-swapped counterpart for this source and nonnegative SR2-generator extensions. Other kernels, generic 4x4 PPT states, SN>=3 witnesses, external/formal review and novelty remain open.
